text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! This is how I run! Did it make 
your heart go jumping?! At this rate, 
victory over Taiki is mine as well!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, Taiki can't debut anytime soon!? 
What am I supposed to do with my burning 
soul?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If it's come to this, I'm gonna run wild 
myself in the Junior class! First up is 
the Daily Hai Junior Stakes—look at me!
